'''Maniacal monkeys''' are located in [[Kruk's Dungeon]] which the player visits during [[Monkey Madness II]].

Compared to the [[Skeleton (Ape Atoll)|skeletal monkeys]] in the [[Ape Atoll Dungeon]], maniacal monkeys may be seen as a better choice for players wishing to train [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] with multi-target attacks due to their extremely dense spawn and much lower defence. However, as maniacal monkeys are '''not''' undead, the effects of the [[salve amulet(ei)]] do not apply, whilst they do for the skeletal monkeys. On the other hand, maniacal monkeys have a high aggression range and come in large quantities, and also commonly drop one-dose [[prayer potion]]s to replenish prayer points. These potions are dropped more frequently than used, reducing the overall cost of training here. The lower level of Kruk's Dungeon may require a [[Light sources|light source]].
